name: Exeggcute

1.name: Growth Spurt
1.effect: Take a [G] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Exeggutor

1.name: Psychic
1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Each of Exeggutor’s three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don’t seem to be very interested in one another.

1.name: Powerful Bloom
1.effect: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

name: Snivy
flavour_text: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.

name: Servine
flavour_text: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

name: Serperior

ability.name: Jungle Totem
ability.effect: Each [G] Energy attached to your [G] Pokémon provides 2 [G] Energy. This effect doesn't stack.

flavour_text: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.

name: Morelull
flavour_text: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull’s head. The caps regrow overnight.

name: Shiinotic

1.name: Flickering Spores
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

name: Dhelmise

1.name: Energy Whip
1.effect: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra [G] Energy attached, this attack does 70 more damage.

flavour_text: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

name: Ponyta

1.name: Stomp
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

flavour_text: It can’t run properly when it’s newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

name: Rapidash

1.name: Rising Lunge
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

name: Magmar

1.name: Fire Blast
1.effect: Discard 2 [R] Energy from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.

name: Larvesta
flavour_text: This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole the Sun. The fire Larvesta spouts from its horns can cut right through a sheet of iron.

name: Volcarona

1.name: Volcanic Ash
1.effect: Discard 2 [R] Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

name: Salandit

1.name: Venoshock
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 40 more damage.

flavour_text: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

name: Salazzle

1.name: Poison Claws
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.

name: Magikarp

1.name: Leap Out
1.effect: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

1.name: Rampaging Whirlpool
1.effect: Discard a random Energy from among the Energy attached to all Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

name: Vaporeon

ability.name: Wash Out
ability.effect: As often as you like during your turn, you may move a [W] Energy from 1 of your Benched [W] Pokémon to your Active [W] Pokémon.

flavour_text: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s.

name: Finneon
flavour_text: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

name: Lumineon

1.name: Aqua Liner
1.effect: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokémon—its natural predators.

name: Chewtle
flavour_text: Its large front tooth is still growing in. When the tooth itches, this Pokémon will bite another Chewtle’s horn, and the two Pokémon will tussle.

name: Drednaw

1.name: Crunch
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its massive, jagged teeth can crush a boulder in a single bite. This Pokémon has an extremely vicious disposition.

name: Cramorant

1.name: Dive
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavour_text: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.

name: Pikachu

1.name: Circle Circuit
1.effect: This attack does 10 damage for each of your Benched [L] Pokémon.

flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Raichu

1.name: Gigashock
1.effect: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Electabuzz

1.name: Thunder Spear
1.effect: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

flavour_text: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.

name: Joltik
flavour_text: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It’s soaking up static electricity because it can’t produce a charge on its own.

name: Galvantula

1.name: Electroweb
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

flavour_text: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

name: Dedenne

1.name: Thunder Shock
1.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

flavour_text: It’s small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people’s homes and charge itself.

name: Mew

1.name: Psy Report
1.effect: Your opponent reveals their hand.

flavour_text: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

2.name: Genome Hacking
2.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

name: Sigilyph

1.name: Spike Draw
1.effect: Draw a card.

flavour_text: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians’ emissaries.

name: Elgyem
flavour_text: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

name: Beheeyem

1.name: Mind Jack
1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

flavour_text: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

name: Flabébé

1.name: Hypnotic Gaze
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

flavour_text: This Pokémon can draw forth the power hidden within blooming wild flowers. It is particularly fond of red flowers.

name: Floette

1.name: Leaf Drain
1.effect: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon draws forth what power is left in withered flowers to make them healthy again. It holds a red flower.

name: Florges

1.name: Bloomshine
1.effect: Heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

flavour_text: This Pokémon creates an impressive flower garden in its territory. It draws forth the power of the red flowers around its neck.

name: Swirlix
flavour_text: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn’t get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

name: Slurpuff
flavour_text: By taking in a person’s scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It’s hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

name: Mankey

1.name: Focus Fist
1.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

flavour_text: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

name: Primeape
flavour_text: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

name: Geodude
flavour_text: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they’re totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

name: Graveler
flavour_text: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

name: Golem

1.name: Guard Press
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes −30 damage from attacks.

flavour_text: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

ability.name: Primeval Law
ability.effect: Your opponent can't play any Pokémon from their hand to evolve their Active Pokémon.

name: Marshadow

1.name: Revenge
1.effect: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

flavour_text: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it’s imitating.

name: Stonjourner
flavour_text: The elemental composition of the rocks that form its body were found to match the bedrock of a land far away from this Pokémon’s habitat.

name: Koffing

1.name: Division
1.effect: Put 1 random Koffing from your deck onto your Bench.

flavour_text: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Weezing

1.name: Smokescreen
1.effect: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to use an attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

flavour_text: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

name: Purrloin
flavour_text: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

name: Liepard
flavour_text: Don’t be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Venipede
flavour_text: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.

name: Whirlipede

1.name: Poison Sting
1.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

flavour_text: This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.

name: Scolipede

1.name: Venoshock
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 more damage.

flavour_text: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claws’ toxic spikes.

name: Druddigon

ability.name: Rough Skin
ability.effect: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, do 20 damage to the Attacking Pokémon.

flavour_text: Druddigon lives in caves, but it never skips sunbathing—it won’t be able to move if its body gets too cold.

name: Pidgey
flavour_text: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgeotto
flavour_text: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

1.name: Scattering Cyclone
1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

name: Tauros

1.name: Fighting Tackle
1.effect: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 80 more damage.

flavour_text: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it’s a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.

name: Eevee

1.name: Continuous Steps
1.effect: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

flavour_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Chatot

1.name: Mimic
1.effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Draw a card for each card in your opponent's hand.

flavour_text: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.

name: Old Amber
card_text: Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Basic [ C ] Pokémon. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. This card can't retreat.

name: Pokémon Flute
card_text: Put a Basic Pokémon from your opponent's discard pile onto their Bench.

name: Mythical Slab
card_text: Look at the top card of your deck. If that card is a [ P ] Pokémon, put it into your hand. If it is not a [ P ] Pokémon, put it on the bottom of your deck.

name: Budding Expeditioner
card_text: Put your Mew ex in the Active Spot into your hand.

name: Blue
card_text: During your opponent's next turn, all of your Pokémon take −10 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

name: Leaf
card_text: During this turn, the Retreat Cost of your Active Pokémon is 2 less.

1.effect: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
